result: Supported native ID assignment and general coordination exist; no dedicated trait-ID reservation API or manual reservation registry found within the bounded ignored-inclusive native search.

interpretation.supported: The launch brief asks for a reservation/coordination contract. PTM add-record Steps 1 and 2 supply the native assignment contract; CLAW's current coordination guide supplies isolated writer branches/worktrees, manifest-scoped repository leases for bounded shared transitions, and Git/PR durable handoff. Using those existing contracts for this already-authorized task need not invent an allocator or a new ID policy.
interpretation.not_supported: A task or status file, supervisor launch receipt, arbitrary local ID ledger, repository lease, grounding-registry lock, seeder merge behavior or generated index cannot be represented as an authoritative durable trait-ID reservation or cross-machine exclusion mechanism.
interpretation.decision_boundary: Root must explicitly retain this distinction in the coordination receipt and complete candidate-specific collision and ownership evidence before writes. If actual reservation is required rather than this documented coordination route, the prerequisite remains unresolved pending identification of its authoritative mechanism.
interpretation.exact_question_if_actual_reservation_req: Which authoritative PTM trait-ID reservation service or registry, owner, and participating-writer protocol must this task use before minting? No such mechanism was located in the bounded current native surfaces; may the existing add-record assignment plus CLAW isolated-worktree/Git-PR coordination contract satisfy the requested coordination prerequisite?

native_sources.claim: Before creation verify primary identifiers, xrefs and synonyms; same-axis equivalents route to enrichment. Prefer a 1:1 external CURIE, otherwise use proteintraitsmech:UPPER_SNAKE_ID for canonical taxonomy nodes. Write via write_record(validate=True).

Use manifest identities; local lease ownership is bounded to short shared transitions; status is advisory; use isolated branches/worktrees and Git/PR state for durable handoff. Cross-machine coordination needs a remote authority.
Historical long-lived worker-lock architecture is retired. Release leases before hook-bearing worker edits; task/status files are advisory.
Documents one worker/task/unique branch/worktree and short metadata locks only. Read as coordination evidence, not invoked to spawn or manipulate sessions.

Canonical template requires immutable/nonreused identity, duplicate/collision/format checks, and repository-owned scheme details. It supplies no allocator or reservation protocol; it is not treated as a rendered PTM skill.
Manifest key proteintraitsmech identifies CultureBotAI/proteintraitsmech and declares coordination_hooks enabled. This audit did not verify installed/active hooks.
Per-record validated atomic replacement; default seed writes merge an existing destination and validation defaults false. No global ID uniqueness or reservation is enforced here.
Reserved supervisor actions suppress duplicate instruction delivery, not trait ID allocation. No-change closure even notes explicit ownership inventory is not yet available.

prewrite_requirements: Root's fresh remote main/open-PR file inventory must supersede premerge reconnaissance; this reviewer performed no network access.

For each candidate, record exact identifier, label/aliases/xrefs, axis/category, destination and maintained writer owner. Search current complete corpus plus ignored/hidden staging/evidence/index surfaces and relevant open/concurrent work; generated labels alone are not exhaustive.
Recheck exact ID/path collisions immediately before the bounded write. A pre-existing destination must stop new-record creation rather than silently invoke seeder merge.
Keep all long-running edits in the already-owned isolated discovery branch/worktree. Preserve all other worktrees and sessions.

Coordinate shared methods, baseline, schema, indexes, source routing and grounding owners. Use manifest-key repository leases only for an actually shared bounded transition; do not hold them across worker turns/hooks.
Use native dry-run validated seeding and one complete canary before a batch of at most10 accepted new records. No old24 enrichment may count as discovery.
Retain PROPOSED and all evidence, licensing, detector, human-review and qualification gates. Durable handoff is the scoped Git/PR artifact, not a claim of global reservation.

standalone_receipt.limitation: Private runtime identities were inspected only in the supplied parent context and are not reproduced here. A null launch blocker does not establish completed candidate-specific ID coordination.

search.limits: Bounded native-document/code search, not all ignored raw datasets, external services, every branch or scientific corpus absence review. Broader coordination follow-up excluded archive/review reports as current authority. One initial search named missing scripts/mech_session_worker.py and exited2; it was repeated without that path and completed successfully.
search.finding: No dedicated current trait-ID allocator or documented manual trait-ID reservation registry found in this scope. Generic coordination and native ID assignment are supported.
